notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44852998/bb455b22753e5ecc0c131cdc3a054bf662577df7.png[/img]

Hi Gardeners,

One of the latest additions to the game we've been working on is the Japanese Garden.
The Japanese Garden is situated on the shore of the main lake in the City Park.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44852998/c9599f6e2e7573bb7822205ec6a0eb83d6c1c7e8.png[/img]


In the Japanese Garden you can add plants to create your own vision

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44852998/ef9853b58a8528f62021c2546744f5ffd6a0165d.png[/img]

After this we plan on adding new jobs to enable you to create new and exciting gardens and structures throughout the park.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44852998/04342d88b9b4789361151b904e9a8a1706232c43.png[/img]

notes.title: Our First Devlog
notes.content:
Hi Gardeners,

We're excited as we've just planted our first Garden Designer devlog!

[previewyoutube=fXE3hPqG3yk;full][/previewyoutube]

We are currently working on mechanics for some of the tools and getting the mower and grass trimmer into cutting order.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44852998/d23169f3d09824627edccf08ce8131fa29bdf53c.jpg[/img]

In addition we are creating new jobs in the City Park that'll release your gardening creative juices as you get to plant new gardens around some of the surrounding Park features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44852998/075897b7840f654ecb9cd0468581e5680f22a794.jpg[/img]

After this we'll be looking at enhancing the building and planting mechanics and we'll look to update you soon on how those are progressing.
